post_hoc_guard.policy: Exact current-time, same-box, high-confidence source-roster bumper read contradicts learned name: suppress to unknown. Never creates a name or propagates across IDs.

limitations: Nine fresh QM3 references and older regression subsets are sparse agent review, not independent human truth, full-match accuracy or an exhaustive ID-switch count. More data raises fresh correct names from 1 to 3 of 9, with five unknown and one missing. Raw V2 has a separate QM13 wrong name. The post-hoc OCR veto removes that known error but needs fresh validation. No default or detector checkpoint changes; no claim of complete paths through occlusion.
